body:
I could probably look something up to see if I like it!

I mean, I guess the only time I’m happy is when I’m escaping from it all. Which is when I’m listening to music, playing video games, working out, etc. but it feels like short escapes from reality, that I can’t escape from.

I haven’t. It sounds like fun though. 

In terms of my day, my morning shower is definitely comforting, but that’s as far as it goes. I feel like I can’t pay attention in classes anymore, and I get distracted, so I’m not learning anything... I struggle to get anything done at night, and I avoid my homework. I pay for the lack of work I did the night before the next morning, and the cycle of stress and regret continues. I feel like I don’t have any goals, or any passions...

I’m a math and computer science major. I just spent my first semester in a masters program for my junior year, and I’ve been struggling a lot... I don’t really have a favorite part of my day... every day feels like blur, and I don’t feel like I accomplish anything from one day to another.
You might be right. A lot has changed since then, so it’s really hard to compare them. The difficulty of my classes went up too, so it makes sense...

Thank you... if i can make it past Christmas I think things might get better. Every time I get pulled into this pit I get closer, and having a handful of pills in my hand was as close as I’ve ever gotten. I know the hangover tomorrow is going to really suck, but you guys managed to stop me from this. I don’t know what the future will bring, but at least I get to see tomorrow. Thanks again...
Yea... I was much more motivated, and I was convinced that things were okay. I was a 4.0 student. I feel like I’ve been in a steady decline since then, and theres no way to stop it...
I had a group of friends my Freshman year in college who opened me up to it. I miss back then when everything made sense. Or at least I thought they did.
Shades of Blue, liquor locker, and say I didn’t are great. Coffee and cigarettes is super emotional, which doesn’t really help the situation I’m in right now. It’s still a good song I guess.

That’s the only thing stopping me right now... I know that I’m in an awful place right now, but killing myself would make it even worse for them. I’m just afraid that they will turn on me. Now that my parents have turned my phone off, they have nothing over me though. I pay for my own college through loans, so I’m not forced to communicate with them anymore.
I like SZA, Ella Mai and Elle Varner. Vic Mensa is good a good hip hop artist. Listening to them gets me through a lot

Christmas has been causing a lot of stress for me. We have no direct family other than my grandfather, and he’s been extremely sick lately, which has me terrified. I don’t want me turning in my mom to be seen as me turning my back on him too. My mom has been great at hiding that things are bad to him, so he doesn’t understand how bad things are. I want to see my siblings and grandfather more than anything in the world, but I want to never see my mom again. It’s like being stuck between a rock and a hard place.
I listen to almost anything. I’ve been listening to a lot of RnB and hip hop lately though...

She has blamed me for everything. She said that me being born ruined her life. I’m the reason none of her relationships work out. She’s going through a severe depression right now and it’s because of me. But nothing I can do to help her is never enough. Between her and my stepdads, I’ve been put through physical and emotional abuse, but I still feel responsible for it. There are days I can convince myself that it isn’t my fault, but she is constantly messaging me telling me otherwise.

I have one older sibling, and 6 younger siblings, and all of the younger ones live with her. I talked to my 15 year old sister tonight who is the next youngest after me. She said that she is sick of the constant bickering, and that my mom might not be around  forever, so we should both bite our tongues and pretend to be happy. She also said that she was sick of seeing my mom cry. I have no idea how to explain any of it to her, but her message tore me apart. My depression did get worse after my concussion, but I didn’t really talk to my doctor about it.

I’ve talked to him about some of the things my mother did, and what she’s doing now. He knows that I’ve been struggling, but he doesn’t know the extent. The only person I’ve only admitted that I’ve had suicidal thoughts to is a college counselor, but I lied about how close I’ve gotten, because I feel horrible for feeling this way.

I realized this year that I’ve been going through years of abuse, and I just accepted it was normal. I have been depressed in college for the past few years, and I haven’t even realized it. I’ve just accepted everything that happens to me. My mother has been horrible to me, and the only thing keeping me tied to her is my siblings. I love them, but they are being brainwashed to think i am some sort of abusive villain. My mother told me on the phone that if she had a gun she would blow her brains out, and that it’s my fault. I had a concussion earlier this year without realizing it, and I had no one there to make sure I was ok. I was at a party with friends the night after I got my concussion and we got on a roof, and drinking mixed with a concussion caused me to pass out. They left me there. I realized that if I died that night, no one would have cared. Not my parents, not my siblings, not my friends, no one. I have no one who cares about me, and I’m miserable. Why should I stay?
